headline.en: UNI trades below the DAO's own $5.96 burn mark with net-inflationary supply and crowded longs — bearish into the v4 fee vote.
headline.zh: UNI跌破DAO自锚定的$5.96回购价, 供给仍净增发, 多头拥挤 — v4费用投票前维持看空.

keyChanges.en: Net inflation persists at +1.84%/yr — $14.52M buyback budget retires only 3.63M UNI against 20M annual emission.
keyChanges.zh: 净增发持续+1.84%/yr — $14.52M回购预算仅销毁3.63M UNI, 对应20M年度增发, 供给端仍是逆风.

keyChanges.en: Two live temp checks target fee expansion: v4 Protocol Fees activation and Robinhood Chain — first credible revenue-base catalyst in months.
keyChanges.zh: 两个temp check同时推进费用扩张: v4协议费激活与Robinhood Chain接入 — 数月来首个可信的收入基数增长催化剂.

keyChanges.en: Binance L/S account ratio at 2.19 on just $4.33M 24h volume — retail longs crowded in a thin book with funding only +0.01%.
keyChanges.zh: Binance多空账户比2.19而24h成交仅$4.33M — 零售多头在薄弱盘口拥挤, funding仅+0.01%, 清算侧极其脆弱.

contrarianObservation.en: Price sits 33% below the DAO's own $5.96 burn-implied fair value while two revenue-expansion temp checks are simultaneously in flight. A smart long can argue the treasury has already revealed its preference at $5.96 and you are accumulating beneath that anchor into a potential fee-base catalyst — asymmetric even if timing is uncertain.
contrarianObservation.zh: 现价较DAO自身$5.96回购隐含公允价低33%, 同时两个收入扩张temp check并行推进. 聪明的多头可以论证: 国库已用真金白银亮明$5.96的底牌, 你正在锚点下方吸筹, 而催化剂就在门口 — 即便时点不确定, 赔率仍不对称.

watchNext.en: v4 Protocol Fees temp check outcome — a pass materially resets the burn-vs-emission math.
watchNext.zh: v4协议费temp check投票结果 — 通过将实质性重构回购与增发的对比.

watchNext.en: Robinhood Chain fee expansion proposal progression — either a new revenue vector or a stall.
watchNext.zh: Robinhood Chain费用扩张提案进展 — 要么打开新收入源, 要么原地搁浅.

watchNext.en: Real-yield RFC re-emergence in the forum — currently absent from top threads, still the single most important variable for UNI's regime shift.
watchNext.zh: real-yield RFC是否重返论坛热帖 — 当前缺席, 却是UNI能否切换估值范式的最关键单一变量.

fullReasoning.en: The setup is bearish but not high-conviction bearish. Price at $3.996 sits 33% below the DAO's $5.96 self-anchored fair value and beneath the $4-7 institutional accumulation band. The core problem remains supply: annualized buybacks retire only 3.63M UNI against 20M emitted, leaving +1.84% net inflation. At ~29x annualized P/S ($2.49B MC / $85.4M revenue) you are paying growth multiples for a dilutive asset. Governance shows the wrong tell — two temp checks address fee expansion (v4, Robinhood Chain), but the real-yield RFC, the single variable that would reprice UNI as a cash-flow asset, is absent from top threads. Derivatives are asymmetric the wrong way: Binance L/S at 2.19 on $4.33M volume signals retail longs crowding a thin book, and +0.01% funding means any flush costs shorts almost nothing. Macro is unhelpful: BTC dominance at 56.76%, ETH at $1.92K, UNI/ETH at 0.002086 near cycle lows. Unichain TVL of $27.62M is a failure-to-launch on the L2 narrative. Stance is bearish on a 1-4 week horizon. Exit conditions are specific: a v4 protocol fee temp check pass, or explicit real-yield RFC return to the forum. Absent either, drift toward the $3-3.5 capitulation zone is the base case.
fullReasoning.zh: 当前定位偏空但信念不满. 价格$3.996较DAO自锚定的$5.96公允价低33%, 也跌破$4-7机构建仓区间下沿. 核心矛盾仍在供给端: 年化buyback仅回购3.63M UNI, 而年度增发20M UNI, 净增发+1.84%/yr. 以$2.49B市值对$85.4M年化收入计算, P/S约29x, 用成长股估值买一个稀释性资产, 性价比不佳. 治理端信号也不对: 两个temp check聚焦费用扩张(v4协议费、Robinhood Chain), 但真正决定UNI能否重估为现金流资产的real-yield RFC在热帖中完全缺席. 衍生品结构不利: Binance多空账户比2.19叠加$4.33M日成交, 说明零售多头在薄弱盘口拥挤, 而funding仅+0.01%, 意味着一旦下杀, 空头付出的持仓成本几乎为零. 宏观同样不友好: BTC dominance升至56.76%, ETH仅$1.92K, UNI/ETH跌至0.002086逼近周期低位. Unichain TVL仅$27.62M, 基本可判L2叙事失败. 1-4周维度维持看空. 翻多触发条件明确: 要么v4协议费temp check通过, 要么real-yield RFC重回论坛主线, 二者必居其一. 若均未发生, 向$3-3.5零售投降区间漂移是基准情形.
